longTitle: Tiny Math Errors That Cost Lives and Millions
sources: Sources: US GAO IMTEC-92-26 (1992); Ariane 501 Inquiry Board (1996); Vancouver Stock Exchange index history.
music_credits: Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.

clips.title: A tiny rounding error killed 28 soldiers #Shorts
clips.desc: Dhahran, 1991: the Patriot missile that never fired. The cause was one tenth.

clips.hook: A clock off by *0.34 s* made a missile miss
clips.title: 0.34 seconds made a Patriot missile miss #Shorts
clips.desc: After 100 hours, the error added up to a third of a second, and 687 meters.

clips.hook: A *$370M* rocket destroyed by one number
clips.title: One number destroyed a $370 million rocket #Shorts
clips.desc: Ariane 5, flight 501: a 64-bit number squeezed into a 16-bit box.

clips.hook: This stock index lost *half its value*… by accident
clips.title: This stock market 'lost' half its value by accident #Shorts
clips.desc: Vancouver, 1982: the index was cut, not rounded, 3,000 times a day.
